question: A ring, a disc, a solid sphere and a hollow sphere, all of the same mass and radius, are released together from rest at the top of the same incline and roll without slipping. The one that reaches the bottom first is the
solution:
$a = \dfrac{g\sin\theta}{1 + k^2/R^2}$: the smaller $\dfrac{k^2}{R^2}$, the larger the acceleration.

Solid sphere $\dfrac{2}{5}$ < disc $\dfrac{1}{2}$ < hollow sphere $\dfrac{2}{3}$ < ring $1$.

The solid sphere wins; the ring comes last. (Mass and radius do not matter.)
